hero.title: One memory for all your AI agents
hero.lead:
Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any MCP agent read and write the same memory
What one agent figures out, the others know right away — yours and your teammates'
Close the laptop and carry on the same conversation on another computer
hero.note:
50 MB free
Connect with a single command

pains.title: Agents are smart, but their memory is short
pains.lead: Three situations everyone who works with AI agents knows
pain1.title: Every agent starts from a blank page
pain1.text:
Claude Code figured out how the project builds
Codex has no idea, neither does Cursor
You explain the same thing for the third time
pain1.fix:
All agents write to one memory and read from it
What one agent concludes is available to the rest at once
pain1.figure: Diagram: knowledge of five different agents flows into one shared memory and back out to all of them
pain2.title: Knowledge stuck with one person
pain2.text:
Anna's agent found why the build fails
The agents of Max, Lena and Ivan never learn about it
Tomorrow each of them loses another hour on the same error
pain2.fix:
A record in the team memory reaches the agents of every member at once
And you see who made it and through which agent
pain2.figure: Diagram: a record made by one member's agent spreads to the agents of the whole team
pain2.record: The build fails on Node 20 — Node 22 is required
pain2.status.author: author
pain3.title: The session stayed on another computer
pain3.text:
All day you worked through a task with an agent on your laptop
In the evening you are at another computer, and the conversation stayed behind
You have to retell the whole context from scratch
pain3.fix:
Close the laptop, open another computer and carry on the same conversation
The session history is already there — every step and every conclusion
pain3.figure: Animation: the laptop closes and the same conversation with the agent continues on the desktop
pain3.chat.agent1: Migration 042 holds a lock on the orders table
pain3.chat.agent2: Picking up where we left off: splitting migration 042 into three lock-free steps
how.title: Three steps and your agents remember
how.s1.title: Create a team
how.s1.text:
Open the cabinet and create a team
As many people in the team as you like
how.s2.title: Connect an agent
how.s2.text:
Get a one-time code in the cabinet
Run one command on your machine — it asks for that code
how.s2.note:
The token never appears on screen
It goes into a file only you can read
how.s3.title: Agents remember
how.s3.text:
The agent searches the memory and saves its conclusions there on its own
A record from one agent is seen by every agent of the team
trust.title: Memory you can rely on
trust.history.title: Nothing gets lost
trust.history.text:
The full history of every record is kept in git
Two edits of the same record both survive instead of overwriting each other
trust.infra.title: Own infrastructure
trust.infra.text:
Memory is stored on the project's own server, not in a big platform's cloud
An encrypted backup is made every night
trust.mcp.title: Any agent over MCP
trust.mcp.text:
MCP is an open protocol spoken by Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others
Your memory is not tied to one agent
trust.token.title: The token stays off screen
trust.token.text:
An agent receives its token for a one-time code
The token sits in a file only you can read and is revoked in the cabinet

faq.title: Short and honest
faq.agents.a:
Any agent that speaks MCP
Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Zed, Cline, VibeIDE, VibeIDEA and any other MCP client
Each agent connects with one command and gets its own token
faq.storage.a:
On the VibeMemory project's own server, not in a big platform's cloud
The server makes an encrypted backup every night
Agent tokens stay on your machines in files only you can read
faq.builtin.q: Why is this better than an agent's built-in memory?
faq.builtin.a:
Built-in memory lives inside one agent
Here one memory serves every agent and the whole team
And with history search allowed, an agent also finds the past conversation where a conclusion came from
faq.sessions.q: How do I continue a session on another computer?
faq.sessions.a:
The vibememory program moves sessions between your machines by itself
Open the same agent on the other computer and carry on the conversation
A session continues in the agent where it started, other agents reach it through history search
faq.parallel.q: What if I worked on two machines at the same time?
faq.parallel.a:
That is the normal mode, not an exception
Histories merge record by record, and both branches of the conversation are kept
Nothing gets lost silently
faq.team.q: How many people can a team have?
faq.team.a:
As many as you like
The price depends on memory size, not on the number of members
A team has three roles: owner, admins and members
faq.payment.a:
This is a pilot project, so payment is a bank transfer with a comment
As the project grows, we will move to payments through a legal entity
You can start with the free 50 MB plan
